title: GREAT LOOKING AND VERY QUIET
text: GREAT LOOKING AND VERY QUIET. I placed this clock on my wall near our breakfast nook.  It goes perfectly with my decor and is very quiet.

product_metadata.title: Bekith 12-Inch Round Classic Clock Retro Non Ticking Quartz Decorative Wall Clock for Living Room Kitchen Home Office
features: Non-ticking Mechanism: Precise quartz sweep movement guarantees accurate time and absolutely quiet environment.
Classic style suitable for classroom, office, living room, guest room, dining room, meeting rooms, restaurant or any other places which needs a peaceful environment.
Easy to Read: Large black numbers are clear to read, front glass cover guarantees perfect view and keeps dust away from dial.
Easy to Hang: Wide slot in back for easy hanging. Powered by 1 AA battery; Battery Not Included.
Vintage and classic looking wall clock, this clock with antiqued bronze frame will dress up any room’s decor.
